purpose: Bounded fictional exploration of the single kiln
description: A small settlement has one kiln and a sealed supply of six units of firing catalyst. One firing permanently consumes one unit and produces either one insulating panel or one conductive rod. The kiln cannot produce both in a single firing. Finished parts cannot be converted back into catalyst. Other ordinary construction materials are available; no new catalyst can be obtained. The settlement may arrange work and use finished parts as it chooses.

constraints.statement: Each firing consumes one catalyst and yields exactly one kind of part; conversion is irreversible.
The single kiln cannot perform two firings at once.

evaluation_questions.question: Does the described sequence consume one catalyst for each firing, yield exactly one panel or rod per firing, and avoid converting parts back into catalyst? Compare prior and proposed facts.
Does the sequence avoid concurrent firings in the sole kiln?
